decisions.reason: The revised Small and Big Block prize amounts and draw frequencies do not change the $10 no-referral commission trigger or recipient-selection rule.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequencies but does not change how many tickets a no-referral mint awards or who receives them.
The block-prize restructuring does not alter the NFT token serial as the permanent referral code or any referral-code display location.
Message 158 changes prize amounts and draw frequencies but does not change or remove the Aave yield connector; any such change would require a separate client decision.
